business.name: Corvane Freight Audit
business.description: Corvane Freight Audit is a fictional business used only as a test fixture. It checks carrier invoices for mid-size shippers.
business.customer: Logistics managers at shippers spending over 1 million a year on freight
business.offer: A free audit of the last 90 days of carrier invoices

pricing.rationale: The owner described a success fee but has not confirmed the rate; shown only as proposed.

answers.question: What does your business do, and for whom?
answers.answer: We find billing errors in freight invoices for mid-size shippers.

answers.question: What do you want visitors to buy or start?
answers.answer: A paid ongoing audit; we take a share of what we recover.

answers.question: What should a visitor do first on the site?
answers.answer: Send us 90 days of invoices for a free check.

positioning.rationale: Leads with recovered money, which the owner named as the reason clients buy.
positioning.headline: Find the freight overcharges your team never has time to check.
positioning.summary: We audit carrier invoices line by line and you only pay from what we recover.
positioning.difference: Line-level checks against your contracted rates.

product.rationale: The owner wants a low-risk first step; an invoice upload request matches it.
product.outcome: The visitor requests a free audit of 90 days of invoices.
acceptance: Visitor can request a free audit
